title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, starting with the first loop. In this loop, draw the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0776). Continue with the third line from (0.75, 0.0776) to (0.0, 0.0776), and finish the loop by drawing the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0776) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero, no further transformation is necessary. Extrude the scaled sketch 0.0155 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional rectangular bar. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This operation will generate a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar are: length of 0.7500000000000001 units, width of 0.07758620689655174 units, and height of 0.015517241379310348 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0776) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0776) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.0155)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
